messages:
Priya: Random question: whats the weirdest hobby youve tried and actually liked? Asking for...a friend. :thinking_face:
Ethan: I got into competitive jigsaw puzzles for a minute. Timed runs are strangely calming.
Marta: Seed saving? Sounds niche but also very nerdy and satisfying. Held onto heirloom tomatoes like trophies.
Hank: I collect retro sandwich wrappers. Very specific, very questionable.
Priya: @Marta seed saving sounds wholesome. @Ethan competitive puzzle speedrunning is peak focus.
OpsBot: Reminder: all hobbies are allowed in break rooms. Please keep the plants watered.
Ethan: Once you do a 500-piece in under 2 hours you get emotional. Highly recommend.
Marta: Seed trade at the next Friday table? I can bring a mini packet.
Hank: If you like weird, I once baked a cake that looked exactly like a handbag. People were confused.
Priya: Oof handbag cake = content. Okay vote: would you rather try seed saving, puzzle speedruns, or vintage wrapper collecting?
Ethan: Puzzle speedruns forever.
Marta: Seed saving for me.
Hank: Wrappers, obviously.
Priya: Tally: 1/1/1. Tie that only a spreadsheet can love.
Priya: Meetup idea: "Low-stakes hobby swap" next Thursday 4pm in the lounge. Bring a thing, teach a tiny trick.
OpsBot: Event posted to #calendar.
Marta: I will bring seeds and stories.
Ethan: Ill bring a small puzzle and a stopwatch.
Hank: I will bring a weird wrapper and a dubious snack.
Priya: Perfect. This is the most non-work initiative we've successfully executed in weeks.
